scope: Research for the homepage services/advantages section only (#advantages). No homepage implementation changes.
assumption: Owner confirmed: keep current categories; research layout and presentation only.
method: Seven Mobbin section searches returned 37 results and 22 unique sections. All returned previews were visually inspected. Eight references selected. High-resolution originals downloaded; canonical Mobbin links retained.
capture_limits: Download date is not capture or redesign date. Static screenshots do not establish interaction behavior, responsiveness, accessibility or conversion performance. Source page context is stated per reference.

searches.query: Digital design agency homepage services section listing website design, web development and digital product capabilities
Creative studio homepage services section with large typographic rows, short descriptions and capability lists
Digital studio homepage services overview with three service cards for research, UX UI design and development
Agency homepage services section with expandable rows and a preview image beside service names
Design and development studio homepage what we do section with service headings and brief descriptions
Creative agency homepage section presenting three services with a distinct illustration for each service
Instrument homepage services section with strategy design technology categories and project images

selected.observed: Two wide panels sit beneath a short introduction. Each combines a large service name, a simple graphic and a small link; the panels use contrasting flat colors.
selected.application: Give each of Moriz’s three themes a distinct visual area. Keep the research pills and Party Mode as the first two demonstrations, then define a development demonstration from real material.
selected.tradeoff: The reference has two categories and very little explanatory detail. Moriz needs three themes and visible supporting text; copying the linked cards would imply service pages that are outside this task.
selected.context: Original capture page unconfirmed. The current Fiasco homepage differs, so this is a visual pattern reference rather than a verified current homepage example.

selected.observed: Four text blocks form a two-column arrangement on black. Small muted service labels and fine horizontal rules sit above much larger explanatory paragraphs.
selected.application: Borrow the clear relationship between a theme label and its explanation. Use three concise blocks within the existing section and give development the same clarity as research.
selected.tradeoff: The captured paragraphs are visually dense. Shorten the supporting text and retain Moriz’s existing typography, palette and interactions; four source categories do not change Moriz’s three.
selected.context: Homepage content match: the current basement homepage lists the same four capability groups and descriptions. The screenshot’s exact capture date is unavailable.

selected.pattern: Outcome rows with a highlighted visual
selected.observed: Four large horizontal rows pair a service statement with short explanatory text. The first row has a lighter background and a product image; fine rules separate the rows. Three capability lists follow below.
selected.application: Compare three full-width rows, one per existing theme. Keep the title, explanation and demonstration together; place falling tags and the Party Mode control inside their corresponding rows.
selected.tradeoff: Rows lengthen the section before Projects. The screenshot does not establish whether the highlight follows hover, selection or scrolling; a hover-only design would need a touch and keyboard alternative.
selected.context: Original capture page unconfirmed. Current homepage and About text did not expose matching row content; retained for its composition only.

selected.pattern: Service list beside a shared image
selected.observed: A compact list of eight capabilities sits to the right of one image. Research is dark and emphasized while the other labels are pale; the section has generous blank space.
selected.application: Explore a three-item selector that changes a demonstration beside it. Moriz’s research and Party Mode could provide two of the demonstrations, while each theme’s explanation stays discoverable.
selected.tradeoff: The static capture cannot prove that the image changes or how selection works. This direction hides more content and requires a mobile composition, keyboard operation and a reduced-motion state; it could weaken the current three-theme overview.
selected.context: Original capture page unconfirmed. Treat the selector behavior as a proposed Moriz adaptation, not an observed Fiasco interaction.

selected.observed: Three columns on a dark background have small category labels, larger capability lists and thin vertical rules. The lists differ in length.
selected.application: Keep the three themes recognizable at once and align their headings and supporting text. Use a few concrete capability terms only where they clarify the theme; the research card already contains eight terms.
selected.tradeoff: A long catalogue would repeat the research tags and push project evidence down the page. Borrow grouping and alignment, rather than the full density or the source service labels.
selected.context: Original capture page unconfirmed. The current homepage’s extracted text does not contain this capability list; no current homepage placement is claimed.

selected.pattern: One large statement above grouped services
selected.observed: A large multiline introductory statement spans the upper area. Four service groups sit beneath it in a compact two-by-two arrangement, with category labels darker than the capability lists.
selected.application: If the section needs an introduction, make it one useful sentence connecting research, experience design and development, then let the three existing themes carry the detail.
selected.tradeoff: Another oversized statement could compete with the hero and lengthen the opening. The screenshot’s pale small text is a styling reference only; Moriz’s supporting text still needs readable contrast.
selected.context: Homepage content match: the current Büro homepage contains this introductory statement and all four service groups. No matching capture date is exposed.

selected.pattern: Each service paired with relevant work
selected.observed: Three horizontal rows combine a large service name, a short paragraph, a work link and a rectangular project image. The captured floating navigation highlights About.
selected.application: Pair a theme with a relevant fragment of Moriz’s own work when an approved asset and contribution are available. This is particularly useful for making development concrete.
selected.tradeoff: A full project gallery would duplicate the Projects section immediately below. Keep any proof compact and avoid copying claims, certifications, work links or client imagery.
selected.context: The capture indicates an About context, not a homepage. Included only as a transferable service presentation pattern.

selected.observed: Three bordered columns under a large capabilities heading separate Design, Strategy and Technology. Each column contains a long list divided by horizontal rules; the sidebar highlights Approach.
selected.application: Use the category separation to check whether Moriz’s three themes are distinct and understandable. A compact list of deliverables could help later if the owner supplies them.
selected.tradeoff: This much detail would make the short section feel like a service catalogue. Its sidebar and long lists do not fit the current homepage scope or the interactive demonstrations.
selected.context: The capture indicates an Approach context. Included as a density comparison, not as a homepage model.
